cost_model.commission_note: Applied once per completed round-turn (entry+exit) per contract. If the backtest engine expresses commission per-side, use 1.48 USD/side.
cost_model.fill_resolution_note: NT8 Strategy Analyzer 'Order fill resolution' = Standard on 1-minute bars (no secondary series). Every strategy order is a managed Enter*/Exit* call with no price argument, evaluated OnBarClose at HH:00/HH:30 checkpoints or on any bar with minute-of-day >= 16:00 for FlatEOD, plus the platform session-close exit (IsExitOnSessionCloseStrategy, clock-triggered, INFERRED) (no Set*/Submit*/limit/stop call — OBSERVED in code). That NT8 realises these calls as market orders, so intrabar High/Low ordering does not decide, at a checkpoint with a given position state, whether an order is sent, is INFERRED; 3gm D4 hypothesis 5 (INFERRED) holds that fill resolution could still change how same-bar exit+reverse pairs and the 16:00 orders resolve; via position state (3gm D4 hypothesis 2, INFERRED) that could change which later entries fire. Fill assumed at the next bar's open (INFERRED). CONDITIONAL under the void clause of DECISION_LOG 2026-08-29T00:10:00Z. Proposed limitation wording for backtest reports: 'Fills are optimistic; Standard resolution on 1-minute bars; 2 ticks/side slippage assumed.' Python MC assumes fills already reflect this via the exported NT8 trade list. See DECISIONS.md D-2026-10-30-A.
cost_model.total_cost_breakdown_note: 22.96 = 2.96 commission + 20.00 slippage (4 ticks x 5.00). In ticks: 0.592 commission-equivalent + 4.0 slippage = 4.592 ticks round-turn.
